# Overview & Syllabus Context

According to the [PHY C54 Syllabus](syllabus.qmd), Noninertial Frames are studied in **Weeks 06, 07, and 08** (Taylor Ch 9: 1–10).

## Core Topics
1. **Linearly Accelerating Frames:** Inertial (fictitious) forces $\mathbf{F}_{\text{inertial}} = -m\mathbf{A}_0$ and Einstein's Equivalence Principle.
2. **Rotating Reference Frames:** The time-derivative operator in a frame rotating with angular velocity $\boldsymbol{\Omega}$:
   $$ \left(\frac{d\mathbf{Q}}{dt}\right)_{\text{space}} = \left(\frac{d\mathbf{Q}}{dt}\right)_{\text{body}} + \boldsymbol{\Omega} \times \mathbf{Q} $$
3. **Fictitious Forces:**
   - **Centrifugal Force:** $\mathbf{F}_{\text{cf}} = m(\boldsymbol{\Omega} \times \mathbf{r}) \times \boldsymbol{\Omega} = -m\boldsymbol{\Omega} \times (\boldsymbol{\Omega} \times \mathbf{r})$.
   - **Coriolis Force:** $\mathbf{F}_{\text{cor}} = 2m \mathbf{v}_{\text{rel}} \times \boldsymbol{\Omega}$.
   - **Azimuthal (Euler) Force:** $\mathbf{F}_{\text{euler}} = -m \dot{\boldsymbol{\Omega}} \times \mathbf{r}$.
4. **Physical Manifestations:**
   - Free-fall deflection to the east.
   - Atmospheric cyclonic motion.
   - The Foucault Pendulum and precession of the oscillation plane.

*(Detailed analytical lecture derivations and worked examples will be added here during Weeks 6, 7 & 8).*
